content:
anya: Heads-up — we're enforcing a new privileged session idle timeout starting next week (Mon). Reason: recent audit found several long-lived privileged sessions, increasing blast radius. Please read required actions below.

devon: Timeline?

anya: Enforcement window: 2025-12-15 00:00 UTC. Any privileged session idle for >12 hours will be terminated and users will be prompted to reauth.

samir: What counts as 'privileged' here?

anya: SSH via bastion to prod, console sessions with admin scopes, interactive sessions created via `rwdnctl auth session create` and any session tokens with `role:admin`.

irene: Steps for app owners?

anya: Actions for teams: 1) Audit sessions with this command:
```
rwdnctl sessions list --filter "role:admin OR env:prod" --older-than 12h
```
2) Rotate any service tokens older than 90 days:
```
rwdnctl tokens rotate --older-than 90d --role admin
```
3) Ensure MFA is enforced on all user accounts (contact idp-team@redwood.com if not).

samir: Will this affect cron/batch jobs that use long-lived sessions?

devon: Cron jobs should use non-interactive service tokens scoped to a job role. If you still rely on interactive sessions, we need to migrate them. Check `rwdnctl tokens list --owner your-team`.

anya: If you need exceptions, open a ticket in #eng-security with justification, duration, and mitigation. Exceptions require approval from Security + Infra.

sec-bot: Automated scan (2025-12-08 11:03 UTC) found 7 sessions matching the privileged filter in prod; 3 are >48h. Tickets created: SEC-4621, SEC-4622.

irene: Can we request a short grace period for migration? 48h would be enough for my team.

anya: We can approve a one-time 48h grace for identified tickets. Please include ticket numbers in requests.

devon: Ops will apply enforcement rule at 2025-12-15T00:00:00Z. Final reminder will be posted 24h before enforcement.

samir: Acknowledged — I'll run the audit and start token rotations today. :thumbsup: 

anya: Thanks. Leave audit outputs in the ticket (paste `rwdnctl` output or attach CSV). I'll be available for quick sync at 16:00 UTC.

sec-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2025-12-14 00:00 UTC.
